Section 7

Frequently asked questions

Can I charge at home?+

Yes. The Roam Air's removable battery plugs into any standard home outlet, just like charging a phone.

Where can I charge?+

At home, at a Roam Point near you, or at a full Roam Hub for a fast top-up on longer routes.

How much does charging cost?+

KES 1 per kilometre to charge at home, roughly KES 160 a day for a typical 160 km ride.

How long does the battery last?+

Roam Air batteries are built for daily commercial use across thousands of charge cycles, with health tracked live in the Roam App.

Can I finance it?+

Yes, through M-KOPA, Fortune Credit, Mogo, Watu, Rafiki Bank or Platinum Credit, with terms from 12 to 24 months.

How much can I save?+

At 160 km/day, most riders save around KES 577 versus petrol and KES 213 versus battery swapping, every day.
